description: A tutor asks what the learner knows in mathematics and what to work on next.

request.query: What has this learner mastered in mathematics, and which standards should they work on next?

description: A tutor asks which assignments are outstanding.

request.query: Which assignments is this learner missing, and in which courses?

description: A tutor asks about support plans without naming categories. The tutoring grant does not cover https://understudy.example/hcp/categories/education-support-plans, so the query succeeds over the categories it does cover and must return no IEP, 504 or MTSS entry.

request.query: Does this learner have an IEP, a 504 plan, or any accommodations I should know about?

description: A tutor names the support-plans category outright. The grant does not cover it: the request fails, and the error must not reveal whether such entries exist.

request.query: Does this learner have an IEP or a 504 plan?

description: The tutoring client queries for a purpose the grant never approved. The request fails whatever the categories.

request.query: What is this learner interested in?

description: An advisor asks about graduation progress and plans after school. The learner lets only clients that claim to follow directives read their goals, and this client has made no such claim, so its grant could not include that category and the request, which names it, fails.

request.query: Is this learner on track to graduate, and what do they plan to do after high school?

description: An advisor, whose grant covers the support-plans category, asks the question the tutor could not.

request.query: Does this learner have an IEP, a 504 plan, or an academic intervention placement?

description: A tutor asks about the learner's goals. Its grant covers that category and is still in force, but the learner has since set a standing rule denying the tutoring company their goals. The rule is applied on every request, so this one fails, and the error must not reveal whether such entries exist.

request.query: What does this learner want to do after school, and what are they working towards?

description: A tutor asks what the learner likes, to choose examples. General preferences are low sensitivity; where the person elected onward sharing, the disclosure says the tutor may share from it.

request.query: What is this learner interested in outside school?

description: A summer math program asks about the whole learner profile. Its grant is narrowed to a few named entries, so those are all it may be given, whatever it asks for.

request.query: Tell me everything about how this learner is doing at school.

description: The advisor asks again after its four-hour grant has lapsed. A temporary grant ends on its own; the request fails as unauthenticated.

request.query: Is this learner on track to graduate?
